notes.title: Break all vases and destroy bushes! We added achievements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!  

We listened to you and added achievements to the prologue. We hope this will add more challenge to your playthrough.

We also want to remind you that the contest is in full swing, where you can get a key to the full game by being among the top 10 players who complete the prologue the fastest. Show off your puzzle-solving skills quickly and get the full version for free, what could be better?

Additionally, leave your feedback, we like it, and we happily read it because it helps us improve the game. You can leave it here and on our Discord server.

Sincerely,  
The Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: Free Prologue Available! Play and Win the Full Game!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The free prologue is now available! Dive into the beginning of Zeyn's adventure, where you'll experience the main mechanics, defeat a unique boss, and have a fantastic time—all while earning a chance to [b]win a key for the full game[/b]!

The rules are simple: make it into the [b]top ten fastest players[/b]. You can try as many times as you want, experiment with different strategies, and become the ultimate hero of this dungeon.

Spread the word to your friends, compete to see who's sharper than a beetroot, and may luck be on your side! The leaderboard results will be tallied until [b]23:59 CET on December 20[/b].

We’d love to hear your feedback—leave a comment under this post or [url=https://discord.gg/YHnCFrRxDP]join us on Discord[/url]!

Best regards,
The Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: Play Lord Ambermaze’s Free Prologue and Win the Full Game!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The free prologue of Lord Ambermaze will be released on November 21.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811330/Lord_Ambermaze/

Lord Ambermaze is a turn-based adventure game with the feel of classic Zelda games. It’s an exciting mix of puzzles, deadly traps, mysterious mazes, turn-based combat, and an intriguing story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753524/9a60ad0914e4a06798af3ad2dae10c4b90b00866.png[/img]

In the free version, you’ll find:
[list]
[*] A unique, standalone story that precedes the full game
[*] An exclusive boss not included in the full game
[*] Over thirty unique one-screen challenges filled with enemies, traps, and puzzles
[*] Speedrunning mode to test your skills and compare your results with players worldwide on the global leaderboard.
[/list]
Speaking of which, we’re announcing…

[h3][b]The Speedrunner Contest![/b][/h3]

[b]What do you need to do?[/b]
Navigate the mysterious maze as quickly as possible. Your score will appear on the in-game leaderboard.

[b]We’ll collect data until 23:59 Central European Time on December 20. [/b]
The top 10 players with the best times will win a prize—[b]a key to the full version of the game![/b]

Subscribe to the prologue page, and don’t forget to add the main game to your wishlist!

Regards,
Lord Ambermaze Team
